description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecord class, which represents a record of an employee's immigration documentation such as passports or visas within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for storing details like passport number, issue and expiry dates, comments, and related employee reference, along with ORM mappings for database persistence.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecord
classes.description: Represents employee immigration records such as passports and visas, including details like number, dates, comments, type, status, and country code.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the associated Employee object.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the associated Employee object.

methods.name: getRecordId
methods.description: Returns the record's unique identifier.

methods.name: setRecordId
methods.description: Sets the record's unique identifier.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the passport or visa number.

methods.name: setNumber
methods.description: Sets the passport or visa number.

methods.name: getIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the passport/visa was issued.

methods.name: setIssuedDate
methods.description: Sets the date the passport/visa was issued.

methods.name: getExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the expiry date of the passport/visa.

methods.name: setExpiryDate
methods.description: Sets the expiry date of the passport/visa.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns additional comments.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets additional comments.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the document type (passport or visa).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the document type.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the I-9 form.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the I-9 form.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Returns the date the I-9 form was reviewed.

methods.name: setReviewDate
methods.description: Sets the review date of the I-9 form.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the country code associated with the record.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country code associated with the record.
